name: 74-use-context-frontier
body:
[74-use-context-frontier] Deciding dependency investigated

Desired behavior
Context gathered up to a sufficient basis for the next decision; source requirement's coverage kept.

Executable contract
1. Before a substantial plan, edit, verdict or reliance on an earlier decision: governing requirement + dependencies able to change the verified property.
2. Deciding callers, consumers, contracts, tests, decision records read. search/graph hit = candidate, the source establishes the meaning. Search miss = absence only in the searched area.
3. Search expanded on a concrete new dependency/contradiction. Established bounded relation → targeted reads, no full graph pass. Global + quantified requirements preserved when judging completeness.
4. handoff/compaction → goal, constraints, decisions, active skill/role obligations, open questions, refutations, evidence locators kept; observations ≠ hypotheses. Only stale affected evidence refreshed.

Tools and skills
context_frontier, project-graph, codebase-memory-mcp desirable for complex relations; read/grep suffice for bounded ones. No index → suitable direct check; a graph replaces no runtime 73.

Links: 71-user-intent-outcome, 72-project-sources-details, 73-tests-not-proof, 76-execution-progress-close-questions.

Anti-patterns
All project references for reassurance; copies as independent confirmation; first list as the whole scope; summary turning a hypothesis into fact or renewing old evidence.
